meta.note: Fees and terms are transcribed from vendor official pages; fields not stated on official pages read “Check the official page”. group values: processor (payment processing) / merchant-of-record (Merchant of Record). status values: active (pricing page valid). feeText is the official fee wording; monthlyFee is the monthly-fee wording; morStatus values: yes (itself a Merchant of Record) / managed-payments (only the Managed Payments product is a Merchant of Record). cardRequired null means the official page does not state it. specText is the service scope stated on official pages; durationText states the billing method and term-related facts; limitsText is the key limits stated on official pages; risks are notes; flags are retrieval markers; notes are supplementary notes. claimUrl and sourceUrl are both vendor official pages.

offers.title: Stripe fees
offers.feeText: 2.9% + 30¢ per successful transaction (US domestic cards), international cards +1.5%; Managed Payments 3.5% + Payments fees
offers.monthlyFee: No monthly fee for standard processing; Billing usage-based 0.7%
offers.specText: Standard processing + Managed Payments (MoR, including indirect tax compliance in 75+ countries, fraud prevention, dispute management, invoicing and customer support) + Atlas + Billing + Tax
offers.cardNote: Not stated on the official pages read — check the official page.
offers.limitsText: Official supported-country list: 50 entries; mainland China is not on it; Hong Kong is on the list; India and Indonesia marked Preview; dispute fee $15 each
risks: Mainland China is not on the official supported-country list; direct signup for mainland China entities is not supported
International cards add 1.5% on top of the standard fee
The Managed Payments fee is 3.5% + Payments fees, added together
offers.sourceName: Stripe official pricing page · official supported-country page
offers.notes: Supported-country list: https://stripe.com/en-gi/global. Atlas $500 one-time; register a US company from anywhere.

offers.title: Paddle fees
offers.specText: Global tax compliance, fraud protection, refunds and buyer support; collects the correct tax rate, tracks filing deadlines, submits sales tax filings
offers.cardNote: Not stated on the official pages read — check the official page.
offers.limitsText: Products under $10: contact Paddle to negotiate pricing
risks: Supported countries and verification requirements: check the official page
offers.notes: FAQ wording: no monthly fee, no migration fee, no hidden fees.

offers.title: Lemon Squeezy fees
offers.specText: Sales tax/VAT collection, remittance and filing, AI fraud protection, license keys, subscription billing; email marketing free for up to 500 subscribers; supports PayPal and other payment methods
offers.durationText: Per-transaction billing; the 2026 Update blog states no closing date
offers.cardNote: The pricing page states no card required (no card needed to sign up).
offers.limitsText: Transactions outside the US may carry a small additional fee; details: check the official page
risks: The 2026 Update blog states no closing date or fee rate; post-migration fees follow the Stripe official pricing page
Supported countries and verification requirements: check the official page
offers.sourceName: Lemon Squeezy official pricing page · 2026 Update official blog

offers.title: Polar fees
offers.specText: Merchant of Record; international cards +1.5%; disputes $15 each; payout fees passed through at Stripe cost
offers.durationText: Per-transaction billing; the Early Member rule uses 2026-05-27 as the cutoff
offers.cardNote: Not stated on the official pages read — check the official page.
offers.limitsText: Break-even points (official page figures): Pro about $1,379/month, Growth about $5,634/month, Scale about $19,048/month
risks: International cards +1.5%; disputes $15 each, regardless of outcome
Early Members permanently lose the old rate after upgrading to a paid plan; dropping back to Starter uses the new 5% + 50¢ rate
Supported countries and verification requirements: check the official page
offers.notes: Payout fees: $2 per month with payouts, 0.25% + $0.25 per payout, currency conversion 0.25% (EU)–1%.
